Experiences

Three experiences

Tell me about your event and I'll recommend the right fit.

01

The Hangout

Magic that moves through the room with me. I circulate with a couple of decks of cards, a few coins and a handful of small props, performing for guests one small group at a time, right at arm's length. These are the quick, spontaneous tricks I love most, and they are still impossible.

Best for cocktail hours, receptions and gatherings where guests mingle.

02

The Station

I set up a small table and guests come to me whenever they like, staying for one piece or several. A table lets the magic grow well beyond cards. These are mini shows, not quick tricks. Still up close and hands-on, just a little grander.

Best for longer receptions and open-house style evenings where guests move freely.

03

The Show

The full experience: forty-five minutes of my strongest material for a seated group. Guests become part of the impossible, helping me pull it off, and many will do impossible things themselves.

Best for milestone birthdays, private dinners and corporate evenings.

About

Joshua Stacy

I started doing magic when I was ten, and I never stopped. Nobody handed me a curriculum. I taught myself, and more than twenty years later I'm still learning.

I'm drawn to close-up magic because it's honest. There's no stage, no distance, no curtain. Just a few feet of space and someone watching closely who still can't figure out how it happened. That reaction is the best part of what I do.

I'm the resident tableside magician at Lady Slipper in Bentonville, a member of Ring 403 of the International Brotherhood of Magicians, and I've been featured in the NWA Democrat-Gazette. I live in Fayetteville and perform across Northwest Arkansas.
